verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can repro and fix bugs. Its cloud VM includes a shell and browser, and Computer Use lets it click through UIs and take screenshots, so it can run and exercise a web app while fixing issues. VPN access lets it reach internal services. However, nothing documents debugging a live running application: no debugger attach, breakpoints, browser devtools, console or network inspection, or connecting to a deployed or local dev server from the assistant. Missing for 10: explicit live-debugging tooling (debugger attach, breakpoints, devtools, runtime log inspection), documented workflow for debugging a running web app, and independent hands-on corroboration.
